caption: The drawing features a horizontal rectangular band with a light yellow-orange background that has a wavy, wood grain-like pattern throughout. Through the center of the band runs a decorative border consisting of alternating green and reddish-brown leaves connected by a continuous reddish-brown vine that twists back and forth in a repeating pattern. Small, round, dark red-brown circles appear at each point where the vine crosses. The rest of the image consists of a blank, off-white background with no other objects or designs present outside the main horizontal strip.
title: Decorative Panels
